# Original environment fixture

`environment.bin` and `ggx-prefiltered.bin` are original synthetic pixels generated by this example's `generate-assets.mjs`. No external photograph, model, shader source or image bytes are included. These generated image assets are dedicated to the public domain under [CC0-1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

The analytic scene contains a blue ambient field and three directional colored lobes. GGX radiance prefiltering uses deterministic Hammersley samples, V=N, perceptual roughness squared as alpha, and normalized NdotL-weighted radiance. The mathematical reference is [Filament's IBL derivation](https://google.github.io/filament/main/filament.html#annex/importancesamplingfortheibl); this implementation is original, not copied source.

The generator and GLSL are covered by the repository's MIT license. `environment.json` records source, algorithm, sample count, convolution controls, layout and binary SHA-256 hashes. The byte encoding deliberately matches Cocos's native RGBE base 1.1 and is not a Radiance `.hdr` file or a glTF texture.
